abstract.t: RACR (Recipient-Authorized Content Retrieval, pronounced "racer") is a federated protocol for exchanging recipient-authorized messages between portable identities. Stable decentralized identifiers let participants operate independently of their current hosting providers. RACR uses deterministic Concise Binary Object Representation (CBOR) and CBOR Object Signing and Encryption (COSE) for signed authorization records and message envelopes. A recipient provider validates authorization before retrieving a detached, digest-bound body from the sender provider. This document specifies the protocol architecture, grant-authorized delivery, and privacy boundaries.
